Adverse events by SOC and PT (FDA STF Table 14): the template ae_soc_pt

Source: R/tpl_docs.R
tfl_tpl_ae_soc_pt.Rd

The table template ae_soc_pt, layout hierarchical: a variant of hierarchical (its defaults changed). Its program is one call, tfl_tpl(ard, "ae_soc_pt", ...); a parameter a report leaves out takes the study standard's value, else the variant's default, else the layout's.

Parameters

ParameterTierStageDefaultMaps toWhat
populationrequiredcalloutput.populationthe analysis set's id (SAF)
subsetothercallwhich subjects (R, on the analysis set's ADSL): PART == "Part 1"
hierarchyrequiredcallAEBODSYS, AEDECODthe levels, outer first
dataothercallADAEthe dataset of records
whereusualcallTRTEMFL == "Y"the records kept (R)
byusualcallTRT01Asettings.treatmentthe column variable
any_rowusualcallTRUETRUE: the row of the subjects with any record, first
any_row_labelothercallAny TEAEthat row's label
headingusualcallSystem Organ Class, Preferred Termthe label column's heading, a line a level
sortothercall.overall, group1, .depth, -n, labelplan_sortthe rows' order (plan_sort())
min_pctusualcallplan_filterthe rows kept: this % of subjects or more (plan_filter()); NULL: all
min_pct_inothercallanywhere min_pct is met: "any" column, "all" of them, or the "total" column
count_cellothercallplan_cells.categoricala count's cell, n (%) (plan_cells(categorical = )); NULL: the study standard's
denominatorothercallthe percentages' denominator: NULL the analysis set's subjects, "data" the records' subjects
totalothercallFALSEplan_totalTRUE: a Total column (the analysis again without 'by', plan_total())

Example

plan <- tfl_tpl(ard, "ae_soc_pt", population = "SAF")

See also

tfl_tpl(), tfl_tpl_help(), tfl_tpl_args(), tfl_templates()

tfl_tpl_help("ae_soc_pt", tier = c("required", "usual"))
